# ⚔️ MetalMC 26.3 — Minecraft 26.3 Update

MetalMC now runs **Minecraft 26.3** on top of the latest **Paper**, with every Paper performance patch included and faster defaults out of the box.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **Java 25 or newer is required.** Java 21 servers will not start this build.

---

## ✨ Highlights

### 🆙 Minecraft 26.3
- Built on Paper commit [`21a495c`](https://github.com/PaperMC/Paper/commit/21a495c94c6a623212202ab7badabcd2ad1523ff) for Minecraft 26.3.
- MetalMC is now a proper Paper fork: it pins one Paper commit and keeps its own changes as small patches. Future Minecraft updates are much faster to ship.

### 🚀 All of Paper's performance work, restored
Earlier MetalMC builds were missing Paper's performance patches. They are all back:

| Area | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **Moonrise chunk system** | Multithreaded chunk loading, generation and saving |
| **Alternate Current** | Much faster redstone dust updates |
| **Hopper optimizations** | Cheaper item transfers and inventory lookups |
| **Entity Activation Range 2.0** | Far-away mobs tick less often |
| **Collision, voxel shape and POI optimizations** | Less work per entity per tick |
| **Velocity natives** | Faster network compression and encryption |
| **Anti-Xray** | Ore hiding without the usual TPS cost |

### ⚡ Faster defaults
New installs get these settings in `config/paper-world-defaults.yml`. **Existing configs are not changed.** Only keys you haven't set pick up the new defaults.

| Setting | Paper | MetalMC |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `misc.redstone-implementation` | `VANILLA` | **`ALTERNATE_CURRENT`** |
| `environment.optimize-explosions` | `false` | **`true`** |
| `chunks.prevent-moving-into-unloaded-chunks` | `false` | **`true`** |
| `chunks.entity-per-chunk-save-limit` | unlimited | **XP orbs 16 · arrows 16 · snowballs 8 · fireballs 8** |

Ender pearls stay unlimited so pearl stasis chambers keep working.

> [!TIP]
> If a technical redstone build depends on vanilla update order, set `redstone-implementation: VANILLA` for that world.

### 🧰 Tuned launcher
`start.sh` (Linux/macOS) and `start.bat` (Windows) start the server with **Aikar's G1 flags** plus Java 25's **compact object headers**, which make every Java object smaller and cut memory use and GC pauses.

```bash
MEMORY=6G ./start.sh metalmc-26.3.jar
```

### 🏷️ Branding
- The server reports itself as **Metal**, and it still tells plugins it's Paper-compatible.
- `/version` checks for updates against this repository instead of Paper's.

---

## 🧹 Removed
- **`metal.yml`** and the "async chunk / entity / tile entity" options from earlier releases. These were never connected to the server, so removing them changes nothing at runtime. You can delete an old `metal.yml`.

---

## 📥 Installation

1. Install **Java 25+**.
2. Download **`metalmc-26.3.jar`** below. `start.sh` and `start.bat` are optional.
3. **Back up your worlds.** Worlds from 1.21.x are upgraded to 26.3 on first start and can't be opened on older versions afterwards.
4. Start the server:
   ```bash
   java -Xms4G -Xmx4G -jar metalmc-26.3.jar --nogui
   ```
   Or use the included launcher for the tuned flags.
